mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline (3-month change < 0)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annualized signals inflationary pressure that typically forces central bank rate hikes, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) reflects weakening supply chain activity, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as market sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Rising real sales of retail and food services (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment falling below 130,000 thousand indicates labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL rise (>0.2% MoM) and low FEDFUNDS (<0.2%) create inflationary pressure without monetary offset, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as rate hike expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.
